# Daniel Rodriguez Gonzalez

> Lead machine learning engineer in Dallas, TX, with 10+ years of experience building production statistical and machine learning systems in media and advertising measurement, defense, and consulting. Works on statistical methodology (survey weighting and raking, calibration, Bayesian inference, population estimation) and the verification layer that keeps those systems trustworthy as they change. Doctor of Computer Science (big data analytics), M.S. Data Science, B.S. Engineering.

Name note: he publishes as "D. Rodriguez Gonzalez". The GitHub and LinkedIn handle is "danrgonzalez".

## Pages

- [About](https://danrgonzalez.github.io/index.html): focus areas, working principles, background, contact
- [Experience](https://danrgonzalez.github.io/experience.html): roles, education, certifications, skills
- [Projects](https://danrgonzalez.github.io/projects.html): personal projects, including a market analytics workbench and TSCResNet
- [Research](https://danrgonzalez.github.io/research.html): peer-reviewed papers on residual neural networks for closed-set and open-set human activity recognition, and the doctoral dissertation
- [Notes](https://danrgonzalez.github.io/notes.html): short essays on methods and engineering practice
  - [Reproduce before you replace](https://danrgonzalez.github.io/notes/01-reproduce-before-you-replace.html): migrate a pipeline by first reproducing its published output
  - [Regression-testing nondeterministic solvers](https://danrgonzalez.github.io/notes/02-regression-testing-nondeterministic-solvers.html): layered tests and measured tolerances for iterative solvers
  - [Running coding agents under a verification playbook](https://danrgonzalez.github.io/notes/03-coding-agents-verification-playbook.html): a written playbook where every rule traces to a mistake
  - [Stage, validate, promote](https://danrgonzalez.github.io/notes/04-stage-validate-promote.html): pipelines that write nothing until every check passes, with dry run as the default
  - [Agree on the decision before the code](https://danrgonzalez.github.io/notes/05-agree-on-the-decision-before-the-code.html): surface methodology decisions and their trade-offs before implementation
  - [Evaluating activity recognition honestly](https://danrgonzalez.github.io/notes/06-evaluating-activity-recognition-honestly.html): held-out subjects, macro F1, matched protocols and open-set testing
